name: Sumadhura Capitol Residences
tagline: Space designed for thought and growth
overview: Sumadhura Capitol Residences offers spacious 1, 2, 3 and 4 BHK homes across four towers — Beacon, Pinnacle, Summit and Triumph — in Whitefield, near ITPL. Apartments feature 22 ft. patio-size balconies and layouts from 1,635 to 1,655 sq.ft for the 3 BHK range, along with an on-site gaming zone with bowling alley.
highlights: Four towers: Beacon, Pinnacle, Summit and Triumph
